programme.title: 少林五祖
programme.desc: 将少林寺视为眼中钉的清廷,处心积虑地想一举消灭少林子弟,于是火烧少林寺。事出突然,寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九。其中五名生还弟子,决意为死去的少林弟子报仇。五人潜心修炼终成正果,被后世称为“少林五祖”。

programme.title: 蛇王子
programme.desc: 广西蛇山中有三条巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇将及黄蛇将;一夜三蛇化成人形与苗寨男女载歌载舞,蛇王子更因此爱上苗寨女子黑琴。后苗寨旱灾,蛇王子答应率蛇作法,引水入寨,但条件是要娶黑琴为妻

programme.title: 插翅虎
programme.desc: 若结合武林两大魔头,插翅虎及活阎王,的武功,他们必定独霸武林,江湖又将有一轮腥风血雨。活阎王为促成这个邪恶联盟,决将胞妹嫁给插翅虎。究竟最后二人之毒计会否得逞?谁可挽救一场武林浩劫?

programme.title: 瀛台泣血
programme.desc: 清朝末年,光绪帝亲政后,开始着手维新变法,惜改革触犯了想保全自身富贵功名的官僚的阻扰。支持皇帝变法的康有为性格软弱,坚持变法的谭嗣同难免浮躁,光绪深知自己的处境危险,于是企图利用袁世凯去对付握有兵权的荣禄。但在关键时刻,袁世凯见风使舵却向荣禄告了密,出卖了光绪

programme.title: 飞燕金刀
programme.desc: 总镖头李志山的妻子私通对头人龙震天,并设计先偷飞龙刀,再杀害李志山及女儿小燕,幸好最后李氏父女成功逃脱。小燕长大后,更成为武功高强的女剑客,誓要为死去的母亲报仇。直至一个偶然的机会,小燕遇到仍然在生的母亲,才骇然发现真相,原来自己一直被父亲的谎言所蒙骗。

programme.title: 兰屿之歌
programme.desc: 兰屿红虫为患,岛上人只信大头目及巫医巴达两人。年青医生何维德到兰屿找寻曾到此研究红虫而失踪的父亲,因而与未婚妻白丹娜闹翻。后来何与孤女雅兰相爱,惹来西呼达嫉妒;同时何为岛民治病,令巴达信众日减,西呼达、巴达均伺机杀何,何身陷险境而不自知……

programme.title: 广东靓仔玉
programme.desc: 清廷高手骆一虎杀害反清义士陈贵,陈妻偕女小薇逃往广龙镇。镇上两家武馆势成水火,何教头之侄家玉生性调皮,因营救小薇识破了老师为反清首领的身份。随著至亲与恩师相继丧命于骆一虎之手,原本好胜顽皮的家玉愤而承担起复仇重任,与清廷势力展开生死决战。

programme.title: 儿女是我们的
programme.desc: 富家小姐梅淑卿与穷教师江少文,为了自由恋爱,脱离父母,从城市迁往小镇结婚生活。他们生育五个儿女,但生存的担子日重,二人长期辛劳,终相继亡故。小儿女顿失庇荫,直接面对复杂的社会,几乎各散东西……

programme.title: 盗剑
programme.desc: 韩九重为夺削铁如泥的青霜剑,诱杀师弟谈鹤鸣;谈鹤鸣的妻子耿六娘隐姓埋名在将军府为佣,伺机夺剑报仇。将军女儿娇龙拜六娘为师,练成一身武艺,并与六娘师侄罗翼虎相恋。翼虎顺娇龙之意,深夜到亲王府盗剑,然而寡不敌众,失手被擒;娇龙率众营救,与韩九重等人展开连场激战。

programme.title: 萧十一郎
programme.desc: 萧十一郎被人冒名作恶,送割鹿刀托连城璧杀萧。宝刀途中被轩辕无敌夺去。轩欲强抢美女沈璧君,萧英雄救美。萧行踪败露,被连伏击重伤,幸为沈所救。萧决意将宝刀取回

programme.title: 大罗剑侠
programme.desc: 女侠明珠的师父遭黑虎帮歹徒偷袭重伤,临终嘱往找故友之女青青,探问失踪财宝。歹徒偷听得遗言,先去劫走青青,途遇「大罗剑侠」周应龙,怒打不平……

programme.title: 金石情
programme.desc: 刘贞莲不幸身患麻疯,其父刘员外招赘穷书生李孝文为婿,意图卖疯传毒。贞莲将真相和盘托出,孝文感于贞莲真情,决意回乡禀明母亲,迎接贞莲返家。孝文走后,贞莲万念俱灰,竟狂饮毒酒,以图自尽

programme.title: 皇家大贼
programme.desc: 干探周福祥的好友阿金因误杀途人而辞职,沦为职业杀手。金所执行的多宗凶杀案中,恰巧由周负责,好友二人面临生死决斗

programme.title: 茅山僵尸拳
programme.desc: 以「赶尸」为业的陈师父与徒弟受托押运九具僵尸,启程上路。未料途中两具竟逃脱。其中一具实际上并非僵尸,而是为躲避敌人追杀而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是,此人与陈师父同样身怀绝技,二人皆为深不可测的武林高手!

programme.title: 至尊一剑
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新剑术高超,连败九十九名剑手,终在最后一击败在剑神手上。五新知其欠缺一柄宝剑,遂杀死著名铸剑师老鹰,夺取稀世的「老鹰宝剑」。老鹰之子燕北悲痛万分,矢誓报仇,不自量力挑战五新,结果被打落悬崖之下

programme.title: 至尊一剑
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新剑术高超,连败九十九名剑手,终在最后一击败在剑神手上。五新知其欠缺一柄宝剑,遂杀死著名铸剑师老鹰,夺取稀世的「老鹰宝剑」。老鹰之子燕北悲痛万分,矢誓报仇,不自量力挑战五新,结果被打落悬崖之下

programme.title: 卖命小子
programme.desc: 武林名门世家子弟袁鹰飞为了对付虎威镖局少镖头关云,拉拢四位失意江湖高手对付他。岂料四人与关云不打不相识,反成好友。后袁鹰飞设下毒计害死关云,四人悲愤交集,遂联手为友复仇。

programme.title: 魂断奈何天
programme.desc: 良才见秋容貌美,心怀不轨,竟将其迷奸。秋容醒来后为良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他禀明父母后会娶她为妻。谁知数月后,良才音讯全无,秋容更发现自已怀有身孕,于是马上去找良才。可惜那时秋容才发现良才已另娶名门闺秀为妻,更打算将秋容灭口…

programme.title: 无名英雄
programme.desc: 街头浪荡客孟刚与铁虎虽玩世不恭,却心怀侠义。一次偶然,孟刚结识革命军首领万泰,在其感召下,两兄弟决心投身革命。在孟刚女友的协助下,他们成功潜入军阀阵营,智取军火送往前线。然而,在与军阀的激战中,三人相继壮烈牺牲,成为湮没于历史中的「无名英雄」。

programme.title: 春火
programme.desc: 杨国良是探长儿子,国良怪父沉迷工作,母离世仍在查案,隔膜顿生。国良遇上舞女梅琳,两人母亲皆殁,了解下迅即同居生活。国良因生活费花尽到俱乐部赌钱,被陈彪骗下巨款,更强奸梅琳。国良愤然杀死陈彪,遭警察围捕

programme.title: 盘丝洞
programme.desc: 本片为邵氏「西游记」系列的第三部作品。唐僧落入了七位蜘蛛精的手中,希望食唐僧肉而得到永生。悟空、八戒和沙僧因此大闹盘丝洞拯救唐僧。

programme.title: 十三太保
programme.desc: 故事讲述于唐朝年间,沙陀国主有十三义子,皆获太保衔。姜大卫饰演的十三太保为战场精英,因而引起兄弟间的嫉妒及挑拨离间,最后更演变成兄弟相残。

programme.title: 儒侠
programme.desc: 年轻剑客沈秉义受命出任爱国组织「日月会」总舵主,誓要讨伐勾结外敌、祸国殃民的大将军。在舍身报国的征途中,他先后邂逅豪爽女侠与两位美若天仙的维族公主。面对国仇家恨与三段缠绵深情,这位剑客陷入了情义两难的抉择。

programme.title: 血手印
programme.desc: 穷书生林肇德与富翁女儿订亲,但富翁因其家道中落而反对婚事。为迎娶挚爱,肇德上京考取功名,临行前会晤未婚妻,怎料却碰上婢女满身鲜血伏尸后花园。因不慎留下血手印于门上,他更被诬陷杀人。直至包公及时重审,为他洗脱冤情。

programme.title: 成记茶楼
programme.desc: 大哥成从大陆逃到香港,在屋邨经营茶楼,本想安分守己,却屡遭恶势力挑衅,而警方却袖手旁观,迫使大哥成和茶楼的朋友们决定以牙还牙!

programme.title: 邪斗邪
programme.desc: 余腩沉溺赌海,由于欠债累累无力偿还,遂答应债主以其妻肉偿债项。事件被其妻识破,并决意离余而去。余动轻生念头,可最终自杀未遂。余遇上一名富家老伯,老伯答应给余巨额现金,只要余答应帮他娶得美人归

programme.title: 恶虎村
programme.desc: 九姑娘之兄巴杰勾结恶虎村恶霸胡蛟,图劫镖银,被「铁沙掌」骆宏勋打伤。胡蛟恐事发后被巴家追究,下毒将巴杰毒毙,嫁祸骆宏勋,巴家上下誓欲杀死骆报仇……

programme.title: 怒海情仇
programme.desc: 故事描述,青年渔夫鲁金虎与渔女小玉自幼相好;土豪独子耀祖,垂涎小玉美色,时借故亲近;一天耀祖欺负寡妇五嫂,金虎抱不平,几动武,惹小玉误会金虎与五嫂有不寻常关系…

programme.title: 英雄无泪
programme.desc: 江湖异人萧大师铸成宝剑「泪痕剑」,不料该剑显现出凶兆,将会带来武林浩劫,而他的亲生子注定要死在此剑之下。萧为了使此剑不危害江湖,将它交给一位淡薄名利的弟子保管。数十年后该弟子把它传给门徒小高,令其带剑下山望化解江湖劫数。

programme.title: 女秀才
programme.desc: 闻蜚蛾自幼女扮男装从父习武,后更考得秀才功名,堪称文武全才。同窗好友杜子中与魏撰之虽与蜚蛾日夕相对,均不知其是女儿身。闻母见女儿年纪不小,不该再扮男装,劝蜚蛾选撰之或子中为夫婿。不料蜚娥与二人情谊相同,一时无法抉择,遂决定由天定夺,怎知阴差阳错,选婿之箭落于撰之手中。蜚娥后悔不已,才知自己意属子中…

programme.title: 女秀才
programme.desc: 闻蜚蛾自幼女扮男装从父习武,后更考得秀才功名,堪称文武全才。同窗好友杜子中与魏撰之虽与蜚蛾日夕相对,均不知其是女儿身。闻母见女儿年纪不小,不该再扮男装,劝蜚蛾选撰之或子中为夫婿。不料蜚娥与二人情谊相同,一时无法抉择,遂决定由天定夺,怎知阴差阳错,选婿之箭落于撰之手中。蜚娥后悔不已,才知自己意属子中…

programme.title: 十字锁喉手
programme.desc: 李成鹰的父亲被多年好友凌豪设计所杀。李成鹰从父亲身上学会“十字锁喉手”的秘技,誓要为死去的父亲报仇。于是,他潜入凌家作护卫,期间也巧遇失散多年的兄长,两兄弟联手大战杀父仇人。

programme.title: 大地儿女
programme.desc: 这是一部经典战争巨片,描述抗日战争时人民的生活状况。画家俞瑞意外救了由乡下被拐卖来的女子荷花。两人互生情愫,不久更结为夫妻过著幸福的日子。无奈好景不常,不久日军全面侵入中国,亦正式展开残酷的统治…

programme.title: 文素臣
programme.desc: 「龙门七侠」之首文素臣命六侠入昭庆寺探察,他们不慎被主持明空杀害。明空更设计杀害林巡按,幸得文所救。文素臣潜入寺内与明空一战为六侠报仇,林巡按下令官兵攻入昭庆寺,联合文歼灭所有奸僧。

programme.title: 邪完再邪
programme.desc: 女鬼刘阿翠钟情以前邻居马素,欲与其结合,央求父亲携同金银珠宝向马提亲,撮合一段人鬼姻缘,马素年青憨直,不愿与鬼为伍,坚决拒绝,实则彼暗恋已有男友之邻居红卜卜,阿翠洞悉其情,决定伺机行动。

programme.title: 广东十虎与后五虎
programme.desc: 广东十虎之一谭敏之侄谭聪,在赌馆当巡场;一夜,十虎的徒弟及后人等四人,在赌场相聚时,旗人佟七带著前清官之子小虎突袭,把谭聪杀死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、谭敏等,昔日曾把父杀死,以助反清义士蔡民义脱险。小虎遂与师叔们联手,杀死仍在世的十虎及其后人、传人,为父报仇

programme.title: 梅山收七怪
programme.desc: 小哪吒偷吃了仙界桃树的一个新结仙桃,但又不慎将另外七个仙桃弄落凡间,导致七只不同动物变成妖怪。哪吒要在十天内收复妖怪,否则父亲会被天帝惩罚。到底哪吒能否完成任务?

programme.title: 马哥波罗
programme.desc: 故事描述东游至中国的马哥波罗,听从元世祖忽必烈忠告,到中国各地考察三年,回京后,适逢忽遭反元志士刺杀,幸得蒙古高手护驾,一死一逃;马凭死者遗言,判断余党必在扬州;马被任命为总督,率兵将反元者一网打尽;惟马抵扬后,有感于汉人抗异族的无比决心,遂将蒙兵来攻之事暗告反元志士

programme.title: 仙女下凡
programme.desc: 天宫仙女七妹向往凡间生活,某夜偷驾祥云下凡来到香港。初到人间的她人生地不熟,险遭不法之徒欺骗,幸得经营负债累累孤儿院的董自立相救。面对贪婪富商觊觎院址、步步紧逼,七妹屡施法术相助,却屡遭误解为妖魅。两人在困境中互相扶持,情愫渐生,共同守护孤儿院的未来。

programme.title: 玉面飞狐
programme.desc: 夏梧与司马秋同为镖局掌门义子。司马秋利欲薰心,设计弑杀师父,更以暗镖毁去夏梧面容。重伤的夏梧怀抱年幼长女逃走,怀孕妻子却于昏迷中遭司马秋奸污。夏梧隐居深山,将仇恨寄托长女青青,苦心培育其成为武艺高强的「玉面飞狐」,命她下山劫镖寻仇。

programme.title: 鬼屋丽人
programme.desc: 本片是根据《聊斋》中之《书痴》改编,故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺负,搬进常闹鬼的「孝廉府」。然后玉柱遇上了颜如玉,二人及后结成夫妇。郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉,将其迷奸。良金妻妾更毒害如玉,如玉化成厉鬼,将中元、良金等人杀害。玉柱因如玉已不在人世,不禁一阵辛酸。

programme.title: 唐人街功夫小子
programme.desc: 青年谭东独自从大陆来港投靠祖父,因与黑社会人物徐豪结怨而遭陷害,迫于无奈偷渡到三藩市。东在唐人街饭店觅得工作,后来又因打抱不平而再牵涉入黑帮恩怨中。东更重遇徐豪,二人展开连场恶战。

programme.title: 裸血
programme.desc: 凌波的丈夫高远及其友王侠,均与肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染,孟借此勒索二人;后孟被杀,高成嫌疑犯,另孟之兄翟诺,亦向高勒索;而凌在家,也接见了谷峰,他声言有为高洗罪的证据,但要索钱;王妻李香君借贷给凌 究竟谁是杀孟真凶?

programme.title: 钻石艳盗
programme.desc: 两大珠宝盗贼「夜来香」和「夜爵士」前往日本,意图偷去「维纳斯的眼泪」巨钻。二人见面后即坠入爱河,却不知道原来对方同为盗取巨钻的竞敌。最后谁会得到巨钻?二人的恋情又会否无疾而终?

programme.title: 没有老公的日子
programme.desc: 黄太太独力抚养儿子Alex成人,与媳妇阿彤一起生活。岂料Alex意外逝世,死前道出外遇女友黑仔已怀有身孕。结果三名没有老公的女人同住一室

programme.title: 英雄帖
programme.desc: 柳非春和龙重九一边游历一边吃好吃的,听说要举办武林盟主大会的比武,柳非春和龙重九来到了举办大会地点藏剑山庄,拜访了龙重九的好友令狐羽庄主。龙重九发现令狐庄主中了噬功散的奇毒,在调查中发现,江湖上三大高手,除了崆峒派掌门唐无影外,中原大侠展梦

programme.title: 快刀斩
programme.desc: 大雨之夜,为县城做完法事由捕头护送回寺的小和尚,拐错岔路无意中发现林府灭门惨案,并救下垂死的新娘柳叶桃。n原本隶属于杀手组织“绮妍堂的柳叶桃,因不忍杀害忠良转而保护林大人,并与林大人日久生情,令“绮妍堂遭受重创,由此引来灭门大祸。所幸死

programme.title: 一路绽放
programme.desc: 主要讲述张杨果而饰演的美丽性感公关盛绮珊、孔琳饰演的老练稳重boss薛云、崔程程饰演的青春活力设计小白夏思佳三人经历了一场相遇到相知的过程,经历了相惜到反目的过程,一起失业,一起创业,一起经历了人生中的喜怒哀乐。

programme.title: 激情跳水梦
programme.desc: 跳水梦,讲述中国跳水运动员在追逐梦想道路上所经历的困惑、矛盾和思考,以个人为切入点,以两个不同时代出生的年轻运动员为代表,探讨竞技运动中个人和集体、个人和荣誉之间的关系。

programme.title: 我是杀手女仆

programme.title: 九色鹿王: 前尘

programme.title: 鳄梦岛

programme.desc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴会中为心仪女子桃宝一掷千金,却被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐气愤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通缉。为了躲避追捕,唐伪装成太监潜入宫中,却阴差阳错被卷入闽南王冯达的造反事件。唐得知造

programme.title: 新精武门: 武魂
programme.desc: 武林大会时,盟主霍长空与血魔罗决战时输了,血魔亦元气大伤,危急关头霍将功力注入刘晶体内,刘意外获得内力。十四年后,刘在隅然机会下来到“霍家拳馆,阴差阳错遇到血魔罗重出江湖找霍家人报仇。有著霍长空功力

programme.title: 幽灵狙击手
programme.desc: 雷霆安保公司的幽灵小队,由林森带领队友执行解救女科学家南茜的任务。众人救南后在撤离时见到一名小孩被关在笼里,赶去营救,却听到枪响,之后全军覆没。于伟刚写下小说“幽灵狙击的一段,跟著一声枪响,被击中头

programme.title: 伏妖开封府之御猫展昭
programme.desc: 北宋时期,宦官专权,邪灵横行,汴梁境内兴起了许多邪教,其中最大势力是“外九流。开封府里的包拯、展昭和公孙策秘密审理邪灵案,然而“外九流的人试图毒害包拯,还筹划著更庞大的阴谋。面对此情况,开封府众人

programme.title: 聊斋古卷: 兰若之境
programme.desc: 蒲松龄在写故事时无意打开了生老病三道门的封印,放出了巨树之妖黑山的分身。天女发现黑山,与其大打出手,不幸身形被灭,要借助蒲的妻子甄娘化为人形。打斗中她们被黑山所困,天女告知蒲若要救出甄娘,他得要感动三

programme.title: 精武陈真
programme.desc: 为了取长补短,陈真远赴日本学习工业技术。留学期间,陈真与擅长形意拳的武术家薛自立一起,为了捍卫中国人民的尊严,他们勇敢面对日本军部官员的比武挑战。一场中国功夫大师与日本武士的较量正式上演,比武场上陈真

programme.title: 末世人间道
programme.desc: 茍胜、富贵等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆发,感染者失去理智,疯狂地撕咬其他人。茍胜带领众人逃离酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡过程中与感染者发生了激烈搏斗。随后逃亡队伍内部又突爆矛盾及冲突,互相猜忌。

programme.title: 猎杀无人区
programme.desc: 在无人区的荒野里正发生著一场惊险的生死追踪。少年堇言意外拍下了盗猎者袭击警方的场面,不幸被歹徒发现后击伤了堇。他忍耐著疼痛一路逃走,其后这帮人还挟持堇的姐姐朴雨。两姐弟在无人区里奋力逃走,凭借著坚强意

programme.title: 剑王朝之九境长生
programme.desc: 在蘅王统治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣带诏。蘅王请魏侯爷找出衣带诏,并要派杀手杀死名单上所有人。白山水和谢柔均在名单上,而谢柔的弟弟谢长胜对白心生爱慕,与其他杀手一路追踪白到客栈。

programme.title: 狄仁杰之恢诡赤目

programme.desc: 正邪之首,龙门及异门在昆仑之巅决战,异门被灭,龙门首领朗炎建立龙都城,并设立龙雀卫组织。转眼十二年后,突然朗遭蜘蛛人袭击中毒,龙雀卫首领方圆及圣女姬心在调查袭击事件的过程中,发现异门后人利用噬魂蜘蛛企

programme.desc: 武周时期,生活在洛阳洛河水两端但不同出生的两个少女意外被卷入悬案之中。一位是金吾卫队长的女儿赵青青,另一位是生于市井底层的女孩小骗子。她们一同遭遇在洛阳城内一连串匪夷所思的离奇案件,二人组成了临时搭档

programme.title: 裂战

programme.desc: 在无间的生死大战中,动物已经进化出各种各样的颜色,图案和形状,帮助它们捕猎,隐藏和保护自己我们在本集解释了一些最有趣的伪装和变色能力

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #5 英普
programme.desc: 野狗群的世界正在面对一场巨变,他们丰富的狩猎地正受到斑点鬣狗群的威胁脆弱的狗宝宝已开始挨饿,因为无情的猎食者对手偷走了他们的食物,最终还突击他们的栖身地

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #6 英普
programme.desc: 对狮子来说,水牛固然是令人满足的晚餐,但同时也是危险的猎物与穆瓦姆巴狮群一起追踪为数近三百头水牛,并从中窥探他们的猎食技巧,他们必须迅速而谨慎地行动

programme.title: 月球野性面 #3

programme.title: 大猫国度 #1
programme.desc: 在卢安瓜谷,强大的孟巴肯高狮群仍有17头壮狮,但老化的雄性领导无以为继在北方,荷里活狮群中的六只雌狮已经自给自足了三年,但没有雄性与她们交配,可能导致族群灭绝四名年轻流浪雄狮突然的造访,似乎回应著荷里活狮群的祈祷

programme.title: 大猫国度 #2
programme.desc: 在卢安瓜谷,荷里活狮群大难临头流浪雄狮的侵袭使女族长阿华受了重伤由于首领丧失能力,狩猎变得困难在寻找狮子的过程中,阿森发现了一只鬣狗幼崽,牠的母亲去打猎时遗下牠鬣狗与孟巴肯高狮群因争夺一只水牛的尸体而大打出手弥敦收到惊喜:孟巴肯高狮群原来藏著更多的幼狮

programme.title: 大猫国度 #3
programme.desc: 四头流浪雄狮组成的暴力团,正寻找可接管的狮群他们在卢安瓜河的西岸徘徊,并已跟北方的荷里活雌狮群大打一场,现正南下进入强大的孟巴肯高狮群的地盘孟巴肯高的雌狮群的狩猎队阻止他们接近,但她们的策略只能持续几天

programme.title: 大猫国度 #4
programme.desc: 流浪雄狮最近的入侵将孟巴肯高狮群分散到了遥远的南方,留下那些失去了首领- 叛逆者的保护,易遭攻击的幼狮现在旱季已经过了一半,炎热的天气降低了河水的水位,金巴和玛雅兄妹俩冒险过河寻找父母

programme.title: 大猫国度 #1
programme.desc: 在卢安瓜谷,强大的孟巴肯高狮群仍有17头壮狮,但老化的雄性领导无以为继在北方,荷里活狮群中的六只雌狮已经自给自足了三年,但没有雄性与她们交配,可能导致族群灭绝四名年轻流浪雄狮突然的造访,似乎回应著荷里活狮群的祈祷

programme.title: 大猫国度 #2
programme.desc: 在卢安瓜谷,荷里活狮群大难临头流浪雄狮的侵袭使女族长阿华受了重伤由于首领丧失能力,狩猎变得困难在寻找狮子的过程中,阿森发现了一只鬣狗幼崽,牠的母亲去打猎时遗下牠鬣狗与孟巴肯高狮群因争夺一只水牛的尸体而大打出手弥敦收到惊喜:孟巴肯高狮群原来藏著更多的幼狮

programme.title: 大猫国度 #3
programme.desc: 四头流浪雄狮组成的暴力团,正寻找可接管的狮群他们在卢安瓜河的西岸徘徊,并已跟北方的荷里活雌狮群大打一场,现正南下进入强大的孟巴肯高狮群的地盘孟巴肯高的雌狮群的狩猎队阻止他们接近,但她们的策略只能持续几天

programme.title: 大猫国度 #4
programme.desc: 流浪雄狮最近的入侵将孟巴肯高狮群分散到了遥远的南方,留下那些失去了首领- 叛逆者的保护,易遭攻击的幼狮现在旱季已经过了一半,炎热的天气降低了河水的水位,金巴和玛雅兄妹俩冒险过河寻找父母

programme.title: 大猫国度 #5
programme.desc: 在卢安瓜谷的荷里活狮群正身处水深火热向北避难以逃离流浪雄狮,其他狮子来到威胁霸占牠们的领土当牠们尝试回归时,流浪雄狮又赶到阻止牠们前进

programme.title: 大猫国度 #6
programme.desc: 旱季即将结束,孟巴肯高狮群面临前所未有的艰难时刻牠们的女族长和最强猎人苏拉比被一头水牛所伤,让她命悬一线同时,弥敦找到了狮群中最年轻的成员之一,孤身走失的小狮斑点

programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡罗瓦的一座鲑鱼养殖场,了解纽西兰帝王鲑与大西洋鲑的不同之处他亲自捕捞鲑鱼,并在俯瞰港湾的海岸边烹调他也介绍了一款高品质的本地食用油,兼具健康与多功能性,体现对本地农业与永续的承诺

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛产季节!Ben 造访中奥塔哥一个由家族经营的果园,该果园以核果产季长,与土地及社区的紧密连结而闻名他发现了一座全电力运作的樱桃农场,将优质外销樱桃直接贩售给纽西兰民众

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 体验鲁阿佩胡地区正崛起的饮食文化,以及悠久的市集园艺历史他拜访了一位第六代农夫,该农夫将一片偏远荒野打造成繁荣的生态旅游与高级餐饮目的地,并与一位屡获殊荣的主厨合作

programme.title: 艾伦康明最奢华的火车之旅:苏格兰 #1
programme.desc: 艾伦从爱丁堡出发,探索一列奢华列车,与列车主厨会面,造访二战与雅各宾纪念地,漫步于莫拉的银白沙滩,并了解西高地铁路的工程奇迹

programme.title: 任天堂的故事
programme.desc: 由制造花札卡牌默默发迹,到成为世上最受认可的电子游戏公司之一,从玛利欧和路易吉的诞生到大金刚和萨尔达⋯⋯到击败竞争对手并成为高品质游戏和强大价值的平台这就是任天堂的故事

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #1
programme.desc: 位于汉堡芬肯维德的空中巴士工厂拥有超过 16,000名工人和工程师设计,生产和交付整个欧盟中那些业内领先的飞机

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #2
programme.desc: 每十分钟就有一辆新卡车从生产线出货,配备了度身订制的生产线,以满足瑞典汽车集团-富豪的个别客户需求

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #1
programme.desc: 在贝里斯,詹姆斯与奥利弗·菲力普斯与阿尔菲·伊诺奇相聚他们探索拉马奈的玛雅遗址,走访水洞,了解门诺会文化,巡礼圣佩德罗的街头美食,飞越蓝洞,并在霍尔香珊瑚礁潜水

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #2
programme.desc: 在新加坡,马克·威廉士加入菲力普斯双胞胎的行列,他们骑著侧边车穿越唐人街,体验舞狮,并搭乘渡轮前往乌敏岛划划皮艇穿梭红树林在这趟刺激的旅程中,他们还深入探索了娘惹文化,历史文物与在地美食

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #3
programme.desc: 与嘉宾柯瑞·米克利斯特一起,詹姆斯和奥利弗造访了墨尔本他们游览雅拉河,观赏菲利普岛的小企鹅,驾驶卡丁车,乘坐普芬比利蒸汽火车,在贝尔斯海滩体验冲浪课程,还在一架二战老式飞机上上演空中特技

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #4
programme.desc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奥利弗于加拉达塔与娜塔莉·提娜会合他们横渡博斯普鲁斯海峡,乘坐东方快车列车穿过雪山体验雪地摩托车,并在市场品尝土耳其美食,果油饼(Baklava)与异国香料

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #5
programme.desc: 双胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博尔城遇见了阿尔菲·艾伦他们在最古老的古巴餐厅用餐,与坦帕湾闪电队打冰球,打棒球,享用在地海鲜与啤酒,并探访这座城市最著名的闹鬼饭店

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #6
programme.desc: 在智利圣地牙哥与热妮西斯·罗德里格兹会面后,詹姆斯和奥利弗参观了青金石工作坊,体验马戏团,并学习了库埃卡舞(Cueca)他们还游览了壮丽的葡萄园,品尝顶级葡萄酒,并亲手制作传统恩潘纳达饼(Empanadas)

programme.title: 惠妮休斯顿: 天籁背后
programme.desc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描绘惠妮休斯顿如流星般崛起的人生--从福音音乐的根源到全球巨星的巅峰,揭开错综复杂的情感关系,与成瘾搏斗的阴影,以及那把曾无可动摇,最终令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮

programme.title: 揭秘芭比:分裂的梦幻屋
programme.desc: 《揭秘芭比:分裂的梦幻屋》揭示创作芭比娃娃背后的戏剧性真实故事,重点讲述联合创作者罗丝韩德勒和杰克瑞恩的高山与低谷,以及他们标志性又备受争议发明的持久影响

programme.title: 天空之眼 #1
programme.desc: 一趟视觉震撼的俯瞰之旅,带您横跨非洲,澳洲与斯堪地那维亚三大绝美胜地全程采用 4K 摄影机精细捕捉,精致刻画出广袤多元的壮丽地貌

programme.title: 天空之眼 #2
programme.desc: 一趟视觉震撼的俯瞰之旅,带您横跨非洲,澳洲与斯堪地那维亚三大绝美胜地全程采用 4K 摄影机精细捕捉,精致刻画出广袤多元的壮丽地貌

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring fieldDr Matt has been called in to lend a hand The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes Matt decides to return another day

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud

programme.desc: The charm of cute rabbits is irresistible! An old man raised hundreds of rabbits?! Playful little rabbits are spoiled yet timid! programme.title: Black and Blue
programme.desc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality

programme.title: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
programme.desc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber

programme.desc: 每天早晨透过诗歌安静心灵,从牧者及嘉宾的分享学习《圣经》中的真理,让观众由浅入深认识信仰,默想《圣经》教导。

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神秘
programme.desc: 从世界各地搜集到数以百计奇异事物内容,都是无法以一般人接受的观点加以解释,除非这个世界在科学理论上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地

programme.title: 如果还有明天5 我为上帝精彩过
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下错车,弄得满身伤痕、万劫不复,惟有祂并不介意我们的过去,愿意领我们走向美好的将来。《如果还有明天5我为上帝精彩过》,深入中国广西山区孤儿院,记录残障青年在信仰中找回尊严和盼望的故事。摄制队再远赴南半球,见证澳洲天生失明女歌手及轮椅上的妈妈,突破身体局限活出主爱无限;还有美国摘冠

programme.title: 主日讲坛-中国基督教播道会同福堂
programme.desc: 中国基督教播道会同福堂 讲题:变身!变新! 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪。透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意。

阿妈教落食平D粤
programme.desc: 谁说电饭煲一定要煮饭？肥妈相信，小小的电饭煲，也可完成炖汤、煲粥、煲糖水的任务！用电饭煲炖汤前，为何要先「煮毛巾」？肥妈买来三种番薯，准备煲「栗子地瓜滑鸡丸粥」，顺道提及想买较甜煨番薯的注意地方。上辑曾用慢煮棒慢煮猪扒，原来电饭煲亦可「慢煮乳鸽」，但一定要煮好汁料，不能偷懒！六号化身韩兵，听从指令煮出潮流「韩式部队锅」，亦按指示逐一放入「芋头椰香喳咋」的材料，同时发挥「灵活变通不浪费」的精神！

programme.title: 才骏HASHTAG 科技新指标粤
流行都市粤
programme.desc: 脑积水乍听骇人，「水」其实从何而来？神经外科医生指这状况有机会源于脑肿瘤，可怎样确诊？医生强调先找方法处理脑积水以降低脑压，再施外科手术切除肿瘤，并考虑脑水的引流方法。「三太」樊亦敏以新角色「龚喜」加入《三代同糖》，继《开心速递》后再「回家」，发放欢乐！主持关注到三太身型上的改变外，也好奇她如何于日常生活保持正能量；曾因患病引致严重脱发的她又是如何跨过逆境？「睇𩠌食饭」，三姐奉上「芋香腐乳焖鸡」。

programme.title: BB要健康粤
programme.desc: 不少父母会为孩子报读Playgroup、学前班等，究竟是否必要？今集请来朱凯婷、邓梓峰、杨思琦参与讨论。兼顾幼儿教育事业的梓峰不鼓励父母陪同子女上课，凯婷竟有不同看法？言语治疗师指出六岁前是学习语言的黄金期，家长可怎样协助训练？心理学家提到Messy Play能让婴幼儿透过感觉学习，节目介绍个中特点。管教孩子常会出现无法预料的情况，爸妈的情绪管理备受考验。梓峰便曾因生气向女儿淋冻水，到底发生何事？

老表，你好hea！#24粤
programme.desc: 利亚激发露宿者对音乐的斗志，林雪内心暗喜。静雯为了在野，决定离开家庭，秋水只有答应两人婚事。结婚当日，齐家出尽方法为难在野。婚宴上，林雪送上惊喜。秋水担心在野收入，尤长说会分钱，令尤田感不公平……

樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 藤木因为在公园不小心弄乱了别人以橡子砌的图形，因此以叶片留下讯息道歉。第二天，藤木发现对方留言回应了。爷爷因为多次答错电视问答节目的问题，而被小丸子认为爷爷的说话不可信。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 蚌蚌公主想好打气方法，要在零食小兵团做任务时给予支持，令这次到访的四位小兵都信心满满。果园采摘任务，虽然曲奇队曾摘错水果，而薯片队又误碰了铃铛一次，但两队都能于一分钟内完成任务，莫非想挑战最快通关纪录？「厂长话」热身赛中，某男兵自知有轻微失误，迅速作出调整，然而到淘汰赛时，却又避不开陷阱？拼砌汉堡包游戏，薯片队不断用说话提醒自己的下一步，曲奇队稍一不慎看错了食材的次序，便有所落后……

programme.title: 面包超人粤日

骗中传奇#4粤PG
programme.desc: 方孔不忿玉麟放走忠正二人，使出横手令二人再入狱，更从顾井师父顾残生手上取得假铜币做证。公堂上，玉麟利用化金水拆穿铜钱藏金技俩，不料铜钱真的藏有真金。玉麟查出铜钱藏金乃残生所为。残生力劝忠正要重新做人，不要再令余实费心，忠正动容。残生在玉麟面前露了一手，玉麟将此事告之方孔。群众均为铜钱而起争执，情况十分混乱。宝儿利用美色骗顾井说出真相，幸忠正及时出现制止。玉麟终想出分辨铜钱藏金方法，残生暗自担心。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 银屑病是发炎性的皮肤病，医学上成因不明，却有一些诱发因素？皮肤科医生藉图片解说不同银屑病的表征，除了外观，这病也可影响其他器官与心理。医生亦会讲述治疗方案，并提供相关的皮肤保养建议。临床心理学家澄清，「微笑抑郁症」非正式精神疾病诊断，而是较通俗说法，来描述外在表现与内在感受存在极大落差。身边的亲友如何察觉？要改善微笑抑郁的倾向，倾诉和关心均是大方向。「睇𩠌食饭」，傅季馨示范经典美食「台式卤肉饭」。

programme.title: BB要健康粤
programme.desc: 新一代父母较认同科学育儿，「四大长老」或偏向相信传统古法，因此可能会引发争拗。今集除了请来儿科医生与资深陪月顾问各抒己见之外，还有心理学家分享遇上矛盾时的处理方法，避免两代争闹。众人又讨论应否以「电子奶嘴」安抚小朋友，嘉宾杨卓娜、林子博与主持陈敏之各自细谈子女使用电子产品的情况；Bob更提到向三女加推「连坐法」，成功培养她们互相提示守规矩！此外，郭田葰会介绍胎儿照相机、人工智能学习程式等新科技。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#26粤
programme.desc: 志咏与桂兰入选视帝视后，在野发动群众，捧父母当选。尤田宣布赛制问题取消两人候选资格，但因群情汹涌，尤田增设最佳临时男女演员奖。在野与静雯被逼打对台，最后志咏与桂兰大热落选，联群杰党与同乡会展开骂战。

programme.title: 阿妈教落食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈花费少许，便做出高级餐厅的「蝴蝶扒配番薯条」美食，蝴蝶扒是怎样切出来的？六号多次偷食未能得逞，只有炫耀自己对煎牛扒的认识。肥妈把400毫升可乐及相若份量的黄酒焖猪踭，再用大杯黄酒及适量黑麻油浸煮猪腰，莫非真的如六号所说，要灌醉另一半讨好对方？浓味的马拉盏酱惹人喜爱，若想避免味精、防腐剂，肥妈教大家家中自制！再配上蟹爪及秋葵，煮出的「马拉盏蟹爪鸡肉炒秋葵」，足以吸引另一半回家吃饭。

programme.title: 夸极限大挑战粤
programme.desc: 林师杰、林泳淘、陈婉衡远赴新山挑战障碍赛，先到香港区赛场实地考察，再在教练帮助下锻炼体能。三人抵达新山，由武吉仕林王宫、陈旭年文化街，走到丛林，爬上隐世树屋，婉衡一展「树上瑜伽」，又藉水上障碍赛热身，却失手掉下水。比赛当日，师杰轻松过关，同时揭开摄影师的拍摄功架。泳淘在众人鼓励下，拿出最大意志，克服单绳上攀！马来西亚跑手CK先天失去左手，但凭毅力完成赛事，他示范搬运碎石桶，令师杰佩服不已！

programme.title: Do姐有问题粤
programme.desc: 多位「好戏之人」同来接受Do姐考验，田蕊妮与李思捷组队，迎战黎耀祥和胡定欣。泰国夜市海鲜档为食客提供「三宝」，当中的冰桶有甚么作用？阿田答对题目，为何却咀咒自己会扣分？台北猫舍收容了不少猫猫，负责人想出「屎桥」，能让猫咪们「自给自足」！东京老字号专卖店主打一种竹制品，到底是甚么？雨伞专门店有售超过一万把雨伞，其中一款设计独特的「缩骨遮」更可用作保护某物件。今集兑换奖金创出新高，哪一队是幸运儿？

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 热血军检
programme.desc: 【安普贤携手曹宝儿，成最强军检察官搭档！！】以韩国军事法庭为背景，为了各自目的而成为军检察官，都培万只想往上爬达成复仇目标，车友仁出身军法世家，为替父母讨回公道而回到军中。当军中黑暗势力浮上台面，他们选择不再服从命令，而是直面权力、揭露真相。在正义与复仇之间，两人逐步找回真正的信念，也点燃危险又炙热的同盟关系，从对立到并肩作战的故事。

programme.title: 裸婚时代
programme.desc: 【八年爱情遇上现实婚后生活秒变修罗场】刘易阳与童佳倩相恋八年，决定在怀孕之际不顾家境悬殊与双方父母的强烈反对，选择没房、没车、没钻戒、没婚礼的「裸婚」。两人原以为爱情足以抵挡现实，但婚后却发现，与易阳父母同住的压力、两家价值观的冲突，以及柴米油盐的重担正逐步侵蚀他们的浪漫。当理想被生活逼到墙角，这对一路走来的恋人，究竟能否守住最初的承诺，为爱打下一个真正的家？

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 模范刑警
programme.desc: 【孙贤周携手张胜祖，最强刑警搭档追查冤案揭开真相！！】资深刑警姜道昌凭经验与直觉，与只相信证据的天才刑警吴志赫成了新搭档。两人办案风格迥异，从冲突到合作，逐渐建立默契。面对五年前女高中生遇害的案件出现新的疑点，两人联手出击揭开掩盖的真相，对抗试图隐瞒冤案的权力与势力找出真凶。

programme.title: 风起西州
programme.desc: 【《风起霓裳》最新续作！！许魏洲、古力娜扎续夫妻情缘，琴瑟和鸣的婚后生活及事业新考验！！】制衣才女库狄琉璃与裴行俭婚后面对大长公主的屡次使计刁难，琉璃聪慧应对，化险为夷。裴行俭因意外被贬远赴西州上任，夫妻携手同心，琉璃发挥自己的长才，传授西州百姓制衣技巧。裴行俭则守护西州百姓经济富足、安居乐业。

programme.desc: 【横跨两国人气演员的偶像剧，张哲瀚携手朴敏英初尝试爱情罗曼史！！】乐观积极的元气少女许真，在前往盖亚影视应征时撞见了当红炸子鸡顾持钧被前女友拒绝的场面。不希望丢脸的事情曝光的顾持钧则从中作梗想赶走许真，却阴错阳差的在盖亚集团二公子林晋修的帮助下，反而成为了顾持钧的助理。朝夕相处、情愫蔓延，却同时卷入了集团的阴谋，两人要如何逃出危机，让有情人终成眷属呢?

programme.title: 模范刑警
programme.desc: 【孙贤周携手张胜祖，最强刑警搭档追查冤案揭开真相！！】资深刑警姜道昌凭经验与直觉，与只相信证据的天才刑警吴志赫成了新搭档。两人办案风格迥异，从冲突到合作，逐渐建立默契。面对五年前女高中生遇害的案件出现新的疑点，两人联手出击揭开掩盖的真相，对抗试图隐瞒冤案的权力与势力找出真凶。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 热血军检
programme.desc: 【安普贤携手曹宝儿，成最强军检察官搭档！！】以韩国军事法庭为背景，为了各自目的而成为军检察官，都培万只想往上爬达成复仇目标，车友仁出身军法世家，为替父母讨回公道而回到军中。当军中黑暗势力浮上台面，他们选择不再服从命令，而是直面权力、揭露真相。在正义与复仇之间，两人逐步找回真正的信念，也点燃危险又炙热的同盟关系，从对立到并肩作战的故事。

programme.title: 裸婚时代
programme.desc: 【八年爱情遇上现实婚后生活秒变修罗场】刘易阳与童佳倩相恋八年，决定在怀孕之际不顾家境悬殊与双方父母的强烈反对，选择没房、没车、没钻戒、没婚礼的「裸婚」。两人原以为爱情足以抵挡现实，但婚后却发现，与易阳父母同住的压力、两家价值观的冲突，以及柴米油盐的重担正逐步侵蚀他们的浪漫。当理想被生活逼到墙角，这对一路走来的恋人，究竟能否守住最初的承诺，为爱打下一个真正的家？

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.desc: Fernando is a good man who takes care of his only child, Daniel. Following the death of his wife Ana, every night Fernando recalls their love as he sorts out his beloved dead spouse’s belongings. One day he finds a VHS tape that will change everything.

programme.desc: A successful and dashing young man whose life of one-night stands seems to be going great until a teenybopper, claiming to be his daughter, knocks on his door.

programme.title: Life Feels Good
programme.desc: The true story of Mateusz, a man suffering from cerebral palsy, who in his early childhood had been diagnosed as a retard with no contact with the outside world. After twenty-five years it turned out that he was a perfectly normal and intelligent person.

programme.title: Vanilla
programme.desc: As debt threatens to tear her family apart, eight-year-old Roberta discovers extraordinary courage in the seven fiercely different women raising her, learning that a family's greatest strength is standing together.

programme.title: The Vanishing Soldier
programme.desc: An 18-year-old Israeli soldier flees the Gaza battlefield and heads back to his girlfriend in Tel Aviv only to discover that the military elite is convinced he was kidnapped in the fog of war.

programme.title: Brides
programme.desc: Inspired by real life events, two teenage girls in search of freedom and belonging leave the UK behind on a secret, dangerous journey to Syria. When their plan falls apart in Istanbul, they're forced to go it alone, testing everything they believe in.

programme.title: In Other Circumstances: Valley of Darkness
programme.desc: What if your own mind is hiding the truth? After Detective Brauner is shot during a mountain hike, he wakes with no memory of what happened. As Jana Winter investigates, the greatest mystery may be the one inside his fractured mind.

programme.title: The Breach
programme.desc: A fatal car crash shudders a crisis-torn family. Completely lost and shaken to the core by his wife’s death, the husband undertakes his own investigation and learns the shattering truth about his spouse’s genuine woes and longings.

programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Making Friends Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are off for a Jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee but everything they do is different.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Biogas Power
programme.desc: Glitch is excited when Lars refits the Grimbler with new, clean biogas boosters that could make it even faster than the Vroomster! The boosters run on gas made from food waste, and luckily there is plenty of leftover food in the academy canteen for the Grimbots to gather up. But Glitch overloads the boosters and BOOM! He loses control of the Grimbler and is sent flying across the academy, out of control. Lars leads the Go Jetters into action by giving chase across land and sea in the their all-a

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Tepui Mountains, Venezuela
programme.desc: Foz, Kyan and Lars are climbing a Tepui in Venezuela, with Xuli exploring this amazing place in her Vroomster. Meanwhile, Grandmaster Glitch is lost and looking for his Grimbots in the thick clouds around the Tepui. He flies up and collides with the Vroomster, causing Xuli and him to crash into a sinkhole. With the Vroomster and their radios broken, it's up to them to find a way out together. However, their reluctance to form a team causes even more problems when a disagreement results in them l

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Too Loud, Thomas!
programme.desc: After Thomas loses his voice, he must find a new way to pass on a very important message.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Butterflies
programme.desc: When Nikhil sets out on a mission to spot butterflies, he's determined to do it alone. Will Jay's butterfly fairy magic get in the way, or will it help Nikhil after all?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Flower
programme.desc: Fifi asks Stanley to help her find a new place for her friend Isabelle the Sun-bell Daisy. This proves trickier than initially planned as Isabelle has some specific needs.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Den
programme.desc: Little Woo and Seamus call Stanley to help them build a den so they can watch the bugs in the forest without disturbing them. After some trial and error, Stanley builds a giant, camouflaged den on legs.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - My Grandad Sometimes Steals My Chocolate Buttons
programme.desc: From tickles and piggybacks to no longer being able to do cartwheels, grandparents are brilliant!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to make music
programme.desc: JoJo discovers that Gran Gran used to be in a band and decides that she wants to learn to play the drums. Gran Gran teaches JoJo how to play a beat, and eventually they form a new band!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Relax
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Spooky Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing dress up when they hear a ghostly sound. They can see that something has spooked the chickens, so they stop what they are doing to investigate. They come across several different items, such as ghostly white footprints, and then they spot a floating sheet. What is going on? The Squirrels will have to take the long way round if they want to catch whatever it is.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Obstacle Course Badge
programme.desc: It's time for the annual Animal Obstacle Course Race- the animals need to work together in teams to complete the course. Duggee has his Obstacle Course badge, together with the squirrels they form a team and the fun begins.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Mermaid
programme.desc: Sing along with Maisy Mermaid!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Great Big Painting
programme.desc: One rainy day, Maisy and her friends make a giant painting!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Artichoke
programme.desc: Little artichoke sings about being the rhyming queen.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Brussels Sprout
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's tiny Brussels Sprout performing I'm Mighty and proving how great he is.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Hiccup Havoc
programme.desc: Supertato uses his hiccups to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's jam attack.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Dino Danger
programme.desc: A toy dinosaur escapes from its box and scares the Grape Kids.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Rain
programme.desc: A cloud appears in Teletubbyland and it rains. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa­Laa and Po watch the flowers bloom. Another cloud appears and it rains pink, Tubby Custard!

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gang's conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nation's honour.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Blinded on a counter-terrorism mission, former SWAT captain Dong Gu retires and lives with his daughter. When his old nemesis resurfaces and kidnaps her for an underground trafficking ring, Dong Gu must rely on his heightened hearing and formidable combat skills to hunt down the criminals and rescue his daughter.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: 热海恋歌第16集
programme.desc: 父母亲早逝的英雄，从小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次乡里冲突，英雄和换帖兄弟添财离家北上，进入温泉乡~北投，当起限时专送的机车小弟。在北投，他遇见今生唯一的挚爱秀秀。拥有天生音乐才华的他，最初学习各种乐器只是为了讨秀秀欢心，最后却因此成为名扬北投的「春风」那卡西乐团乐手。可惜两人纯真的恋情，却遭秀秀的养父所反对，英雄却不放弃；纵使在得知秀秀已与日本商人白原订婚之后，英雄仍不死心，继续穿梭在温泉乡崎岖的巷道与繁华的酒宴间，弹著为秀秀所谱写的未完成歌曲，无畏地向全世界宣誓，他要倾尽一生的光阴来爱秀秀…。在秀秀与白元的婚礼上，英雄冲到美川阁，想带秀秀远走高飞！毕竟深爱著英雄的秀秀，身著婚纱、不顾一切坐上他

programme.desc: 林雅美从小活泼聪明，林父身体不好，雅美从十岁开始学做生意，很快地展现她做生意的天赋，雅美是米行的超级业务员，同时也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什么事情，天塌下来，总有大姊撑著。 雅美能干又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是适婚年纪，不过碾米厂家业全仰赖雅美，雅美根本无意出嫁。林父林母紧张，就像米一样，老米在市场上是没有竞争力的。父母积极地为雅美安排相亲，雅美体贴父母的心意，答应了相亲。不过雅美有个但书，她无论如何不要嫁给做生意的人，她已经厌倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要进入婚姻，她只想要找一个老老实实的上班族。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第22集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 幸福的起点第8集
programme.desc: 林雅美从小活泼聪明，林父身体不好，雅美从十岁开始学做生意，很快地展现她做生意的天赋，雅美是米行的超级业务员，同时也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什么事情，天塌下来，总有大姊撑著。 雅美能干又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是适婚年纪，不过碾米厂家业全仰赖雅美，雅美根本无意出嫁。林父林母紧张，就像米一样，老米在市场上是没有竞争力的。父母积极地为雅美安排相亲，雅美体贴父母的心意，答应了相亲。不过雅美有个但书，她无论如何不要嫁给做生意的人，她已经厌倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要进入婚姻，她只想要找一个老老实实的上班族。

programme.title: 大爱医生馆第6917集
programme.desc: 不断汲取新知，已是现代人必备的条件，对于人文精神的掌握，往往显得贫乏。大爱医生馆借由医师专业知识加上俯拾即是的美感经验与与回归人文思想的本怀，期望帮助忙碌的现代人多关心自己与周遭人的身心健康，为医疗节目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 看美善学美善美善剧场第719集
programme.desc: 京都富商的二女儿今井阿浅(波琉饰)在大阪创立矿碳公司、银行、生命保险公司等一系列活动，并竭尽全力设立日本第一所女子大学的故事。阿浅的人物原型是被称为明治时代女中豪杰的实业家广冈浅子。这是晨间剧故事首次从幕府末代拉开序幕，引发热议。同时出演的还有宫崎葵、寺岛忍、玉木宏等演员。

programme.title: 映照人生第526集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第620集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 唱歌给你听第168集
programme.desc: 故事讲述一个在台湾北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父亲不切实际地为这个家带来债务、困扰与纷争。时常失踪的父亲只能由任劳任怨的母亲咬牙把这个家支撑下去。多年后四处飘浪的父亲癌末回来找长大后的女儿，女儿为了处理父亲的临终把本已瓦解的家庭关系，再次找回分散各地家人，并在父亲临终前相互道歉、和解道别。

programme.title: 锦衣之下第55集
programme.desc: 天赋异禀的六扇门女捕快袁今夏（谭松韵饰）因为一桩案件和性情狠辣的锦衣卫陆绎（任嘉伦饰）结下梁子，本是道不同不相为谋，却因惊天密案联手。两人从水火不容到情难自已，命运的纠葛就此旋转一起。

programme.title: 霹雳朝灵阙第29集
programme.desc: 猂劫兵烽，无暇暗劫起，猂族利用地狱鸟力量，动荡苦境之后，雌伏多年的暗劫八无暇，也趁势再出，为阻止这股邪恶势力颠覆中原武林，汤问梦泽山座白象．香六牙，广发天下举锋帖，召开擎天会，聚集西窗月、墨如鸦、不全鹰等汤问英杰，正心六崇越宗主巍翼、太叔望，以及儒道释代表相继响应，血漫河山侠骨烈，亘古之争，胜败由天抑由人？

programme.title: 肯尼NOW星球第9集
programme.desc: NOWnews重磅篮球企划登场！超人气Podcast节目「肯尼NOW星球」将由新竹攻城狮总经理「Kenny哥」高景炎主持，喜欢听他「密」语如珠、用最专业的角度来分析国内篮坛大小事的球迷绝对不要错过！

programme.title: 霹雳侠影之轰霆剑海录第63集
programme.desc: 神州动荡，武林危难，森狱大举入侵，逆海崇帆灭亡，黑海森狱崛起，玄嚣太子领导众多强将，一举攻陷武林。同为皇储，玄灭太子也伺机而出，与玄嚣一争苦境版图，要将森狱版图扩张至苦境，完成个人霸业，以便未来继承阎王之位。道门六杰挺身而出，倦收天与银骠当家等携手抵抗，唯慕峥嵘私心自用，导致无辜伤亡，最终遭受制裁恶有恶报。而玄灭也在过程中败亡，留下玄嚣太子，延续葬天关魔城扩张的计划，最终对上倦收天与银骠当家。森狱潜伏的势力崛起，大太子玄膑协同蜕变黑后，两人暗中关注著玄嚣太子的一切行为，伺机而作。而一生执著于剑道的玄同，也因为论剑海的评剑会，踏入苦 境，追寻属于自己的剑道。究竟是谁的剑？能给予惋红曲追寻的答案。

programme.title: 天子传奇第21集
programme.desc: 商朝第二十八代君－纣王，好大喜功，征战连连，百姓为其榷税征租，贫乏穷困，哀声载道，民心渐失。一日在平魔的庆功宴时，代表大商国运的镇国龙龟猝亡，适时西现紫气，纣王视为必是西出妖孽，足以祸国，便遣妖帅调领大军征剿西岐。 西伯侯姬昌第二子名曰姬发，出世时天空出现异象，百姓皆称其为未来圣主。姬昌算易知悉姬发有九九之命格危在旦夕，便挺险施行九鼎奇法，却因妖帅与九大护卫杀入，反成九五至尊之数。大祭司见弄巧成拙，建请纣王宣召姬发上京面圣，借机要将姬发炼制灵人，代替护国祥物，纣王为保王命，想尽办法不择手段，导致天怒人怨，因此种下亡国败运的祸根。 姬发面圣路上，灾劫连连，有飘渺城之困，却因祸得福习得「浑天宝

programme.title: 霹雳侠影之轰霆剑海录第64集
programme.desc: 神州动荡，武林危难，森狱大举入侵，逆海崇帆灭亡，黑海森狱崛起，玄嚣太子领导众多强将，一举攻陷武林。同为皇储，玄灭太子也伺机而出，与玄嚣一争苦境版图，要将森狱版图扩张至苦境，完成个人霸业，以便未来继承阎王之位。道门六杰挺身而出，倦收天与银骠当家等携手抵抗，唯慕峥嵘私心自用，导致无辜伤亡，最终遭受制裁恶有恶报。而玄灭也在过程中败亡，留下玄嚣太子，延续葬天关魔城扩张的计划，最终对上倦收天与银骠当家。森狱潜伏的势力崛起，大太子玄膑协同蜕变黑后，两人暗中关注著玄嚣太子的一切行为，伺机而作。而一生执著于剑道的玄同，也因为论剑海的评剑会，踏入苦 境，追寻属于自己的剑道。究竟是谁的剑？能给予惋红曲追寻的答案。

programme.desc: 汤恩希望追随父亲的脚步，成为皇家剑客汪汪队一员。他前往巴黎冒险时，遇见喋喋不休的老鼠皮普，为了丰厚的报酬跟随汤恩。汤恩与贴身战友经历无数场战役，不仅要力抗邪恶的红衣主教及其党羽，还要阻止英法爆发战争。历经了这些后，汤恩发现友谊和正义的宝贵价值。汤恩最终能成为剑客汪汪队的一员吗？

programme.desc: (2020)外省老头九孬(丁强 饰)“偶遇”歌厅歌女(尹馨 饰)，枯木逢春的温情让他甘愿接受这场带有目的的陪伴，不知小家温情，更对遥远家乡情感模糊，一无所有的九孬带上歌女远行，可何处是最终归属？从未自主过的人生只能在戏谑中继续茫然度日。

programme.title: 抽象大师马克罗斯科第1集
programme.desc: 他早期也画了人物与风景，但经历人生与第二次世界大战的悲剧后，马克．罗斯科的画中不再有形体，他为自己设定了一项任务；要用最抽象的绘画来呈现人类的情绪，以治愈世界的伤痛。

programme.title: 我的婆婆怎么那么可爱第5集

programme.title: 真情部落格第805集
programme.desc: 自2005年开播以来，《真情部落格》已访问数百位生命勇士。当这些勇士面对生命中的困难时，他们选择依靠对耶稣的信心，勇敢地克服挑战。这些可爱的基督徒愿意与大家分享他们生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是将来自天上的美好福分带给人们。每一个充满血泪的生命见证都是令人震撼的转变，带来最深刻的真实感。

programme.title: 福气人生第811集
programme.desc: 要拥有福气人生，可以透过聆听牧师们以台语分享圣经的真理，让你领受天国满满的福气与祝福。这些牧师们将以深入浅出的方式解释圣经，将其应用于当代生活，让你明白神的心意和计划。通过聆听台语讲道，你可以更深入地理解圣经的教导，并在日常生活中实践。这些讲道将提供实际的指引和智慧，帮助你在家庭、工作、人际关系等各个领域经历神的福气。聆听这样的讲道，你将能够领悟到属天的价值观和生活方式，学习依靠圣灵的带领，活出基督徒的身份和见证。这将使你能够更深入地体验神的爱和恩典，并将其传递给他人。

programme.title: 恩典365第1602集

programme.title: 经典音乐河第131集

programme.desc: 探索产业风情，通过让KC走出去并进行优等食材大搜查的方式来介绍。我们将结合休闲农、渔、牧产业以及各地的产销班，展示各种加值特产品。在轻松活泼的氛围中，我们将向观众介绍农村、养殖渔业和畜牧业的各种风情。 主持人Claire是客家子弟，而Kevin则来自新加坡。他们将从多元的观点出发，呈现台湾饮食文化的融合，包括闽南、客家、外省

programme.title: 共享观点第211集
programme.desc: 《共享观点》期待用分享而非说教的方式和年轻人谈论圣经的观点和真理。透过主持人周巽正牧师和廖文华牧师轻松幽默的对谈，并结合网路社群媒体，分享他们的信仰与生活的经验，传达圣经真理价值观。

programme.title: 转转发现爱第753集

programme.title: 机智青年生活第19集
programme.desc: 聚焦青年生活与职场挑战，探讨现代青年面临的各种议题。 透过访谈与故事分享，展现青年正向成长与自我突破。 结合实用资讯与励志元素，鼓励青年积极面对人生挑战。

programme.title: 遇见祝福第14集

programme.title: 真情部落格第787集
programme.desc: 自2005年开播以来，《真情部落格》已访问数百位生命勇士。当这些勇士面对生命中的困难时，他们选择依靠对耶稣的信心，勇敢地克服挑战。这些可爱的基督徒愿意与大家分享他们生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是将来自天上的美好福分带给人们。每一个充满血泪的生命见证都是令人震撼的转变，带来最深刻的真实感。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第16集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.title: 奥林p客第1634集
programme.desc: 在新的对话中，主持人和机器人阿蓝妹将增加科技互动的元素。参赛孩子们将扮演小博士的角色，从各种主题和发明中学习现代科学和未来科技。每一集将以「一大六小」的竞赛形式进行，并引入四选一的卡牌抽选机制，让孩子们学习团队合作，并在面对不同意见时学会沟通和做出抉择。

programme.title: 绘声绘影第34集
programme.desc: 《绘声绘影》由说书人「阿佳」和手偶「莎士比喵」带领大、小朋友进入故事书的世界，让阅读不再限制于平面纸张，使绘本故事中的人物鲜活起来，将故事的进行配合原图制作成简易的动画，借由影音刺激，产生更多层次感官体验与娱乐效果，多样化的阅读得到前所未有的延伸，提高自我学习的意愿与兴趣。

programme.title: 客家戏曲第1183集

programme.title: 溜面线杂货店第36集
programme.desc: 节目场景复刻了早期客庄邻里间最热闹、也最能聊天的杂货店前空地。在这里，没有刻板的说教，只有银发长辈与主持人，像在大树下乘凉般，自在地聊生活、聊烦恼，也聊那些平常说不出口的心事。

programme.title: 福气来了(南方篇)第115集
programme.desc: 《福气来了 南方篇》将延伸至中南部及花东地区，透过节目提供平台，让乡亲朋友能够走进摄影棚，分享他们的故事，并进行互相交流。在东南部的客家庄里，我们能够欣赏到独特的生活方式，美丽如画的田园风光以及多元的文化。让我们在这个地方，畅谈乡亲们的人生故事。

programme.title: 一家之煮第544集
programme.desc: 走访客庄邀请两组家庭进行对决，借由家人间的默契一起做料理，品尝彼此完成的美食，进而带领观众了解「感动人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或时令蔬果。

programme.title: 学学嘴学学鼻MV时间第3集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙学语的模样，是所有父母最鲜明的亲子时光，而我们客家人有一个词，生动描述了这个过程：「学嘴学鼻」。全新推出的幼儿节目《学学嘴学学鼻》，就是从这四个字延伸而来的创意。我们塑造了两位默剧小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的逻辑，反过来用画面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑说客语，小丑则会搭配幽默逗趣的肢体语言，呈现每集要学习的关键字。

programme.title: 森林侦探队Ⅲ(饶平腔)第19集
programme.desc: 延续前两季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更额外增加了新的冒险伙伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面对接踵而来的森林任务，大家勇敢、热心且不畏艰难地向彼此伸出援手，尽管过程中充满挑战，却也能在每次的行动中获得意想不到的收获

programme.title: 当昼新闻第309集
programme.desc: 《当昼新闻》是一个日间新闻节目，提供即时、全面的国内外新闻报导，涵盖政治、经济、社会、文化等多方面的重要议题。这个节目专注于在白天时段向观众传递当下最重要的新闻资讯，让观众随时掌握时事动向，并对众多议题保持关注和理解。无论是政治动荡、经济变化，或者社会事件和文化创新，这个节目都将为观众带来最及时的报导和解析。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第17集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.desc: 住在美国维州的艾蜜莉，发现女儿好几个小时不太想喝奶，更糟糕的是，女儿的身体状况随著一天天过去而越来越瘫软。经过儿童神经科医生检查发现，女婴的麻痺是从上肢往下蔓延，符合婴儿肉毒杆菌症的情况。 美国人布莱恩到开曼群岛度假时，戴著隐形眼镜下水池、进海里，因而左眼感染棘状变形虫，眼球被寄生虫啃食。

programme.desc: 主持人杰洛米韦德听说，南非布里德河有人捕到有史以来最大的牛鲨，他接受科学考察队的邀请，一同调查这起离奇事件。考察队为了解开谜团，有请韦德帮忙钓鲨鱼，算是韦德面临过最大的钓鱼挑战。他发现布里德河的鲨鱼有十分特定的进食方式，于是他得改变诱饵的呈现方式，好让鲨鱼感兴趣。如果钓到鲨鱼，科学家做完检查就会野放，这使得当地居民一点也不高兴，纷纷表示抗议。更奇怪的是，这里的牛鲨从未攻击人类，于是主持人向当地渔夫打听线索。有人说也许鲨鱼不喜欢人血的味道，有人觉得河里食物太多，所以牠们才对人类不感兴趣。主持人后来更发现布里德河里的牛鲨会跟踪渔船，等鱼上钩就一口咬走。究竟韦德能不能成功钓到牛鲨呢？请看本集的节目。

programme.title: 战痘医师第2季:第11集
programme.desc: 战痘医师桑德拉李这次开刀得特别小心，除了两位病患两上长了东西，更有人仿佛在鼠蹊处长出第三颗睪丸。翠西在20多年来都在忍受布满整脸的硬块，它们从鼻翼途经脸部中央，一路长到额头和下巴，令她在公共场合极度自卑。瑞凡的右腿接近鼠蹊处挂了个大肿块，只靠皮肤相连，外观就像阴囊，举凡生活中的各种活动，从上厕所到去公园运动，全都大受影响。大卫则是在鼻尖冒出了庞大的增生组织，阻碍到鼻孔、也让他在面对人群时很不自在。李医师准备动刀时，却在他脸上发现了更严重的问题。

programme.title: 全美梦幻婚纱第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 密西根州的代表新娘蕾西本来以为要来帮新娘客户做发妆，没想到走进屋却看到蓝迪。蕾西希望找到有密西根春天花朵盛开意象的婚纱。新娘凯蒂带著妈妈、阿姨与姑姑一起来挑婚纱，她们之前已经在另一间婚纱店相中一件，但凯蒂觉得好像没有感受到「新娘的感动」，因此想来克莱菲尔婚纱店确认一下。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第19季:第8集

programme.title: 厨房翻车现场第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 深入美食世界最疯狂、最难以预料的一面！从铁板烧表演的惊人翻车现场，到必须眼见为凭的奇特美食潮流，节目网罗在网路上爆红的精彩时刻。专业主厨也将现身犀利点评，在爆笑反应之余分享行家技巧与实用建议，解析料理究竟为何失败、又为何成功，更教你如何避免在自家厨房重蹈覆辙。节奏轻快、滋味十足的美食探索，集创意、混乱与笑料于一堂。

programme.desc: 超爱买鞋的伊莲天生就有并趾，从小饱受霸凌，也对自己的畸形脚趾感到非常自卑，无法如愿穿漂亮的鞋子。凯丝琳的右脚奇痒无比，甚至要在床边放一把梳子抓痒。

programme.title: 热血兽医师第3季:第8集
programme.desc: 杰夫医生以收费低廉的佛心而闻名，因为他认为即使是低收入的民众，也应该享有负担得起的宠物医疗服务。这天一位饲主泪眼汪汪地带著她的爱犬前来求助，因为牠被马踢中头顶，头部出现凹陷且大量流血。这是相当罕见的病例，即使对经验老到的杰夫医生也是。但杰夫医生仍成功将伤狗颅窦内的骨头碎片一一取出，完成手术，救回牠的命。一只备受疼爱的幼犬腿部骨折，让佩特拉医生面临挑战，因为如果打错骨钉可不能重来。同时杰夫医生为野猫为患的社区解决问题，捕捉大量的野猫带回诊所做结扎手术。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些小动物却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是马达加斯加的番茄蛙。番茄蛙的外型非常抢眼，身体呈现浓郁的血红色，牠是一种突袭掠食者，除了是挖洞高手以外，身上还会分泌剧毒黏液，更可怕的是，牠受到刺激时还会膨胀成巨大的肌肉怪物。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些小动物却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是新墨西哥的北美巨蜈蚣。北美巨蜈蚣在短短几秒内就可以杀死昆虫和小型哺乳动物，因为牠们的身体前方拥有一对力大无穷的毒爪，而且牠们的抓力也非常惊人，可以牢牢抓住所有表面，从任何方向发动攻击，因此猎物一旦落入牠们的掌心，根本没有活命的机会。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些小动物却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是南非的犰狳蜥。犰狳蜥的外观看起来仿佛是神话里的衔尾蛇，牠有咬力超强的双颚，一口就可以把猎物咬到粉身碎骨，此外，牠身上的锯齿状鳞片硬度甚至可媲美金属，全身蜷缩起来的时候宛如一座坚不可摧的堡垒。

programme.title: 动物百分百第3季:第1集
programme.desc: 无尾熊，是澳洲独一无二的代表性动物，这种有袋类因人类猎捕牠们的毛皮，一度濒临灭绝，气候变迁加上野火频繁，牠们的栖地遭到更大威胁，处境更是雪上加霜。

programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些小动物却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是南非的犰狳蜥。犰狳蜥的外观看起来仿佛是神话里的衔尾蛇，牠有咬力超强的双颚，一口就可以把猎物咬到粉身碎骨，此外，牠身上的锯齿状鳞片硬度甚至可媲美金属，全身蜷缩起来的时候宛如一座坚不可摧的堡垒。

programme.title: 动物百分百第3季:第1集
programme.desc: 无尾熊，是澳洲独一无二的代表性动物，这种有袋类因人类猎捕牠们的毛皮，一度濒临灭绝，气候变迁加上野火频繁，牠们的栖地遭到更大威胁，处境更是雪上加霜。

programme.title: 伊拉克救狗行动
programme.desc: 在美国派驻伊拉克的期间，有许多战区的狗儿给了军人无条件的爱。美国的动物防虐单位花了许多时间与心血，特别到战区把这些动物带回美国，与这些军人团聚。

programme.title: 管教恶猫第8季:第5集
programme.desc: 洛杉矶的动物收容所猫满为患，而且每况愈下。当民间的收容所容量已达饱和时，许多幼猫就被送到市立收容所。由于幼猫需要大量的心力照顾，市立收容所没有人力支援，因此假如幼猫没有人认养就会被安乐死。然而洛杉矶根本没有足够的家庭可认养或收养这些猫咪，结果造大量无辜的幼猫面临死亡命运。好友动物协会发起洛杉矶不杀生运动，从市立收容所拯救出50只幼猫，将牠们送到收养家庭照顾到健康的八周，并完成疫苗注射和绝育手术。现在好友动物协会请求杰克森的协助，希望他有人脉能帮助这50只幼猫找到认养的人家。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第7集

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些狠角色却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是南非隐鼠。牠们几乎一辈子都住在地底下；第一眼看到南非隐鼠的时候，肯定会注意到牠巨大的门牙。牠们会用门牙啃出一个地下王国，挖土的功力宛如隧道钻掘机之外，更像是天赋异禀的建筑师，牠们的地下洞穴不仅有好几间干燥的卧室，还有储藏食物的区块，甚至还有独立的茅坑。

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第17集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界第6集
programme.desc: 故事围绕著一个住在平凡城镇、却一点也不平凡的搞怪家庭。这个家庭的成员包括终日待在家中的家庭主「夫」、身高六呎四寸的粉红兔爸爸陶大知，以及在彩虹工厂上班的妈妈陶春娇。他们的孩子也很有特色，有蓝色大头猫阿甘和4岁天才小兔安安，以及原本是宠物金鱼、长了两条腿后就变成家庭成员之一的阿达。

programme.title: 机甲猛斗第3集
programme.desc: 在往学校的路上，孟斗遇上了被一群称作锥筒兵的不良机器人在马路中央建造游泳池而造成大塞车。锥筒兵喜爱建造，但是脾气很糟，于是当孟斗指责他们时，他们合体成为一个叫做超级锥筒兵的大机器人攻击孟斗。运用机甲球的机甲化能力，孟斗击败了锥筒兵，但孟斗并没有送他们进监牢，而是同意如果他们将造成的破坏修复，并保证不会再犯，就可以放他们自由。

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第319集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.title: 少年悍将 Go第1372集
programme.desc: 《少年悍将！GO》是2013年卡通频道和华纳制作的卡通电视节目。也是DC系列《少年悍将》漫画的改编卡通，跟前作不同点在于，本作画法以萌系画风呈现，更大的特点是它著重在喜剧效果上，没有前作的黑暗、严肃气氛，剧中多围绕在少年悍将们的平时生活。本做最大的看点是制作组将许多DC的人物做为背景角色呈现。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第111集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第319集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.title: 机甲猛斗第25集
programme.desc: 在往学校的路上，孟斗遇上了被一群称作锥筒兵的不良机器人在马路中央建造游泳池而造成大塞车。锥筒兵喜爱建造，但是脾气很糟，于是当孟斗指责他们时，他们合体成为一个叫做超级锥筒兵的大机器人攻击孟斗。运用机甲球的机甲化能力，孟斗击败了锥筒兵，但孟斗并没有送他们进监牢，而是同意如果他们将造成的破坏修复，并保证不会再犯，就可以放他们自由。

programme.title: 熊熊宝贝遇见你第10集
programme.desc: 《熊熊遇见你》全新衍伸作品《熊熊宝贝遇见你》将跟著（小宝宝时期的）大大、胖达，以及阿极展开冒险，透过神奇魔法盒，他们穿梭来到如梦似幻的新世界，踏上寻觅容身之处的旅途，希望找寻彼此心中所认可的那个「家」。旅途中他们结识了一些新朋友，也学习了一些新知，他们这才意识到其实只要彼此在一起，无论哪里都可以是彼此认定的「家」。大大宝贝、胖达宝贝和阿极宝贝寻找新家的过程非常艰辛，还被原本的房东赶了出去!他们很希望能够有一个属于自己的家。这时候，他们的箱子上出现了一颗星星，把三只小熊带到了仙子们居住的美丽森林。这里会不会就是他们期盼已久的新家呢?

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第319集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第19集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界第7集
programme.desc: 故事围绕著一个住在平凡城镇、却一点也不平凡的搞怪家庭。这个家庭的成员包括终日待在家中的家庭主「夫」、身高六呎四寸的粉红兔爸爸陶大知，以及在彩虹工厂上班的妈妈陶春娇。他们的孩子也很有特色，有蓝色大头猫阿甘和4岁天才小兔安安，以及原本是宠物金鱼、长了两条腿后就变成家庭成员之一的阿达。

programme.title: 机甲猛斗第4集
programme.desc: 在往学校的路上，孟斗遇上了被一群称作锥筒兵的不良机器人在马路中央建造游泳池而造成大塞车。锥筒兵喜爱建造，但是脾气很糟，于是当孟斗指责他们时，他们合体成为一个叫做超级锥筒兵的大机器人攻击孟斗。运用机甲球的机甲化能力，孟斗击败了锥筒兵，但孟斗并没有送他们进监牢，而是同意如果他们将造成的破坏修复，并保证不会再犯，就可以放他们自由。

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第320集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.desc: 《少年悍将！GO》是2013年卡通频道和华纳制作的卡通电视节目。也是DC系列《少年悍将》漫画的改编卡通，跟前作不同点在于，本作画法以萌系画风呈现，更大的特点是它著重在喜剧效果上，没有前作的黑暗、严肃气氛，剧中多围绕在少年悍将们的平时生活。本做最大的看点是制作组将许多DC的人物做为背景角色呈现。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第112集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第320集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.title: 机甲猛斗第26集
programme.desc: 在往学校的路上，孟斗遇上了被一群称作锥筒兵的不良机器人在马路中央建造游泳池而造成大塞车。锥筒兵喜爱建造，但是脾气很糟，于是当孟斗指责他们时，他们合体成为一个叫做超级锥筒兵的大机器人攻击孟斗。运用机甲球的机甲化能力，孟斗击败了锥筒兵，但孟斗并没有送他们进监牢，而是同意如果他们将造成的破坏修复，并保证不会再犯，就可以放他们自由。
